name: @ci/capacitor-speech
description: Capacitor plugin for offline speech: on-device recognition (STT) and synthesis (TTS). Android uses android.speech.SpeechRecognizer across a three-tier strategy (API 33+ checkRecognitionSupport, 31-32 isOnDeviceRecognitionAvailable, 23-30 EXTRA_PREFER_OFFLINE hint) plus android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech; iOS uses SFSpeechRecognizer with requiresOnDeviceRecognition plus AVSpeechSynthesizer. Every result reports whether local processing was actually guaranteed -- see README.md. Like @ci/capacitor-local-hub (and unlike Android-only @ci/capacitor-local-llm), this plugin ships both native implementations.
